sentences.text: CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUBHASH CHAND -------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Pratiush Lala, Advocate
For the State : Mrs. Shweta Singh, A.P.P  --------
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.P.P for the State.

This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed applicant with prayer to release on bail in connection with Dhanbad P.S. Case No.05 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No.976 of 2022, registered under Sections 467, 468, 471, 419, 420 and 406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier the prayer for bail of the applicant has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 06.05.2022 passed in B.A. No.2356 of 2022 and charge was framed against the accused on 25.05.2022 but till date no witness has been examined by the learned trial court.
The applicant has been languishing in jail since 09.01.2022.
Learned A.P.P opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicant.
The status report was called from the trial court.

In view of the status report, it is found that the charge was framed against the accused Sushil Kumar Singh on 25.05.2022 and till date no witness was examined on behalf of the prosecution, even the informant has not turned up before the learned court below despite issuing summon.
Bailable warrant has also been issued against him on Sushil Kumar Singh @ Sushil Singh @ ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp

sentences.text: In view of the submissions made and materials available on record, the plea raised by learned counsel for the applicant cannot be accepted as a new ground for second bail application.
Accordingly, I am not inclined to reconsider his prayer for regular bail and the same is, hereby rejected.
However, the learned trial court is directed to expedite the trial and to conclude the same within six months.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Rohit/-
